modules.name: dashboard-surfacing
modules.purpose: Deciding what a dashboard surfaces — which of many incoming items earns a tile, a badge, or an alert. Original recombine rule (prose, not yet a decision rule): Suppress when selfResolving is confidently true and severity <= 1. Surface when needsAHuman is at an end. namesTheCause decides whether the tile shows a cause line or a "needs triage" chip.

needsAHuman.instructions: Does this item require a person to do something, as opposed to being informational?
